rows.title: Overview data: book stages, submissions, steps, steps-done counts and leads flag
rows.notes: Data layer only, read only. useOverviewBook() returns { book, submissions, steps: { dueSoon, doneByDay }, hasLeads, hasServicing, isLoading, isError, refetch }; the return shape is documented at the top of the hook. Book needs migration 193 (agent_clients); until it is applied book.available is false and the numbers are null. Saves need servicing_tasks.outcome (193) and read 0 until then. Spec: brain/ohvara/Agent Portal Servicing Spec.md, Overview.
